charts.title: HIP 94235 b: orbits around HIP 94235
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 94235's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 94235 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Zhou et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163..289Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ZHOU_ET_AL_2022): P 7.713057 d

charts.title: HIP 94235 b: its transit
charts.description: HIP 94235 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (101, 103, 104) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 464646604, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 25 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min early; 10-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 8 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
